content.title: Alaska Air Cuts Profit Outlook As Fuel Costs Jump And IT Outage Hits
content.summary: Alaska Air Group Inc. (NYSE:ALK) said Monday it expects third-quarter adjusted earnings per share to come in at the low end of its prior $1.00 to $1.40 forecast, as higher fuel prices and operational issues weighed on results. Refinery disruptions on the West Coast lifted the airline’s expected fuel cost to $2.50 to $2.55 per gallon, above its earlier estimate of about $2.45.
